notification sound.note: For incoming-call ring specifically, existing UI uses 来电铃声.

share extension.note: No existing zh-CN rendering; app UI uses 分享 for Share, so 分享扩展 keeps it consistent.

bottom sheet.note: No existing zh-CN rendering; rarely user-visible.

tap.note: Majority rendering; 轻点 appears in a few marketing-style strings and is the Apple zh-CN convention.

toast.note: No existing zh-CN rendering; rarely user-visible.

clipboard.note: copied to clipboard = 已复制到剪贴板.

passcode.note: Device passcode; existing strings use 密码 (and 密码锁 for 'secured with passcode'), matching Apple's zh-CN term. Distinct from account password only by context.

jailbroken.note: Rendered as 越狱的设备 / 越狱或已 root 的设备; rooted = 已 root.

Face ID.note: Apple's official zh-CN localization is 面容 ID and existing mobile strings already use it (设置 > 面容 ID 与密码).

deep link.note: No existing zh-CN rendering; 深层链接 is the Android/Google official term.

skin tone.note: default skin tone = 默认肤色.

server connection.note: UI strings: Add a server = 添加服务器, Switch server = 切换服务器.
